roles.title: Sell on QuickLocal
roles.blurb: List your shop, take orders from your own neighbourhood, and get paid to your bank.
highlights: Free to list — up to 25 products, no monthly cost
Payouts settled to your bank and reconciled automatically
steps: Install the app and pick Vendor when you sign up
Enter your shop details and the category you sell in
Add your products and open the shop

roles.title: Deliver with QuickLocal
roles.blurb: Choose the jobs that suit you inside a 5 km radius, and know what each one pays before you accept it.
highlights: ₹30 minimum on every order you deliver
₹20 base plus ₹5 a kilometre, paid transparently
Weekly payouts straight to your bank account
steps: Install the app and pick Delivery Partner when you sign up
Add your licence and vehicle details
Go online and start accepting jobs
